1. Three consecutive arenas culminate in the Bone Gate; victory requires all three real clears.
2. Each arena changes its enemy mix and floor/portal identity without covering artwork with text.
3. Four thrall roles actually pursue, flank, lock a charge, or kite/fire a dodgeable sigil.
4. Two elite roles introduce directional guard and a committed two-strike rush.
5. Maw enters phase 2 at half vitality, changes tells/attacks, and still requires a real finisher.
6. Kills and finishers earn soul charges; checkpoint upgrades trade them for blade, vitality or stamina flow.
7. Upgrade prices/caps are enforced; spent charge changes actual combat statistics.
8. Cleared-arena checkpoints bank charges/upgrades; death restores that bank, preventing retry farming.
9. Reload resumes only a valid banked checkpoint; retry and new journey remain distinct controls.
10. It is deep when a natural-input hosted journey earns/spends charge, dies/recovers after a clear, observes varied threats/Maw phase2, and wins all three arenas.
